title: Early Detection of Plant Viral Disease Using Hyperspectral Imaging and Deep Learning.
summary: Full paper reports ML-assisted spectral separation of asymptomatic virus-inoculated grapevines, with small-sample and weak image-test limits.
ai_technology: SVM/RF classifiers use spectral, vegetation-index and pixel features; 2D/3D CNNs extract image features.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Controlled inoculation study reports asymptomatic grapevine spectral differences and classifier results; image-level held-out accuracy is only 50%.
evidence.unknown: The study uses healthy/inoculated vines, cross-validation, and a held-out set from the same experiment; no independent field cohort.
evidence.ai_role: SVM/RF classifiers use spectral, vegetation-index and pixel features; 2D/3D CNNs extract image features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
